notes: The WLED sources a RaceLink firmware image is built from. Both workflows
read this file, so the compile-only build on a pull request rehearses the
exact tree a release would ship -- which it does not do when the upstream
ref is resolved fresh on every run.
ref: a wled/WLED tag, or the string 'latest' to resolve the newest
published upstream release at build time. A pinned tag is the point: WLED
17 switches the shared esp32/esp32s2/esp32s3/esp32c3 build sections from
ESP-IDF 4.4 to 5.5, and every RaceLink profile inherits from them. With
'latest' that toolchain jump would land in a release without a commit here.
patch_prs: upstream pull requests applied on top of that tag, in order.
5521 -- 'Integrate um_data structure to battery usermod'. Still open.
Without it usermods/Battery exposes no um_data, so the RaceLink
usermod's getUMData(USERMOD_ID_BATTERY) never succeeds and the
node reports no battery state -- silently, since the lookup is
retried rather than failed. Watch wled/WLED#5399, which rewrites
the same file: once it merges this patch stops applying.
